newsitem.title: USA: Fed intervenes via round of overnight systems Wed.
newsitem.headline: Fed intervenes via round of overnight systems Wed.

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Wednesday.
The move was not entirely unexpected, but some economists thought the Fed had added enough reserves thus far this maintenance period to remain on the sidelines.
Fed funds were trading at 5.25 percent, same as prior to the operation, and right at the Fed's current target level.
(( -- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663 ))
